evaluation_split: official MIND-small dev archive, reserved as final chronological holdout

data.labels_access: Labels are parsed for strictly delayed causal replay. Current, equal-time and future outcomes never enter a query; metrics wait until all predictions are frozen.
data.metadata_policy: Existing training-archive metadata wins on shared IDs, including any changed text. New metadata is encoded with the frozen hashing/encoder. Availability depends only on observations.
data.timezone: Naive dataset timestamps; no documented geographic timezone.

runtime.timing_scope: Encoding, exact retrieval, scoring, policies, inline exhaustive audit and prediction serialization. Model/index loading included in wall time; metric aggregation and external audit excluded.

prediction_manifest.labels: Prediction code never accesses current labels. Prepared contexts already include only earlier eligible feedback under the frozen causal replay; this is not an entirely label-free test simulation.

comparison_note: All final impressions retained. Logged AUC/nDCG rank the observed slate; catalog recall counts only known logged positives across all earlier observed articles. Session retrieval reranks the union of content100 and popularity100; the content and popularity rows use their own100. These different candidate pools limit direct attribution. Exposure bias prevents causal engagement claims.
